Resolves #22055
Related: #21959, #21942

## Outcome
`show()` mounts a dialog through `initVnode()`, and the lifecycle rename in #7147 (`render` → `initVnode`) left `Neo.dialog.Base`'s override of the offscreen revert on the dead old name. A dialog shown without an `animateTargetId` — `openEventEditor(id)` for a record whose bar is not rendered, `openForRecord(record)`, or any programmatic plain `show()` on a body-rooted dialog — stayed parked at `left/top: -10000px` from `.neo-floating` under its modal mask, with focus trapped in an invisible form.

The override rides `initVnode()` again: same guard (`!me.animateTargetId`), same revert (`wrapperStyle.left/top = 'initial'`), now returning `super.initVnode(mount)`. The animated path is untouched: `animateShow()` awaits `initVnode(true)` with a target set, so the guard skips the revert there, exactly as before the regression. No public API or config changes.

Evidence: L3 (headless-Chromium live probe of the on-screen rect, red on `dev` and on screen with the fix, plus full unit and e2e tiers) -> L2 required (AC-1/AC-2 of #22055 ask for red-on-`dev` and return-payload unit tests; delivered, and exceeded with a live probe).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/dialog/ShowWithoutAnimateTarget.spec.mjs` (new). Red on `dev` with only the src change stashed: `1 failed` on `Expected: "initial" / Received: undefined` (the revert never ran), `1 passed`. Green with the fix: `3 passed`. `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/dialog/ShowWithoutAnimateTarget.spec.mjs` |
| AC-2 | `src/dialog/Base.mjs` returns `super.initVnode(mount)`, pinned in `ShowWithoutAnimateTarget.spec.mjs` across both parent-stubbed arms (`{vnode: {id: dialog.id}}`) and a direct unstubbed `dialog.initVnode(false)` call (`result.vnode.id === dialog.id`). Regression gate: `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/scheduler/EventEditor.spec.mjs test/playwright/e2e/timeline/EventEditor.spec.mjs` — 31 passed with the fix. |
